policy.public_pages_only: Fetch only publicly accessible pages. Respect robots.txt and site terms. Nothing behind a sign-in, paywall or access control.
policy.git_holds: this manifest: URL, retrieval date, SHA-256 of the retained body, labelled spans as minimal excerpts, missingness, rights status; and, for the OGL classes only (rights_policy govuk and public-sector), a page's full text committed for the option pack if the pack needs it, with the OGL attribution
policy.private_body_directory: var/evidence/corpus/ (gitignored through /var/). Proposed here; Task 3 confirms the path in the runbook.
rights_status_values: permitted: <licence or terms, quoted and dated>
reference only: retain minimal excerpts and hash, not the body
<rights_policy class id other than other>: <the terms relied on, quoted and dated> (a page of class other stays 'pending human rights review')

rights_policy.set_by: the product owner at session 1, 2026-10-28 (H-06; the answers in docs/reviews/session-1.md, Part A)
rights_policy.always: Public pages only, nothing behind a login, robots.txt and site terms respected, a third party's personal details (recruiter names, phone numbers) never kept, and for each page the class and the terms relied on recorded in rights_status.

retention_kinds.keep_privately: the full page body in the gitignored var/evidence/ folder on this machine, for local testing only
retention_kinds.commit_excerpts: git holds only the URL, date, hash and the short quoted spans that prove each extracted value
retention_kinds.commit_full_text: the full text in git, with the attribution its licence requires

classes.conditions: Full text only if the option pack needs it, with the OGL attribution.

classes.pages: National Careers Service, Skills England, ONS, Find an Apprenticeship pages (public sector, OGL where they say so)
classes.conditions: As govuk. Full text only for a page that says it is under the OGL, only if the option pack needs it, with the OGL attribution.

classes.pages: College, university and training-provider course pages
Professional bodies and regulators (for example HCPC, NMC)
classes.conditions: As course-provider: never the full text.

classes.pages: Employer job postings on their own careers site or applicant-tracking page
classes.conditions: Excerpts only, never the full text.

classes.pages: Job-board and aggregator pages (for example Indeed, Reed, Totaljobs)
classes.conditions: Reference only: hash and excerpts, never the body, unless the site's terms clearly allow more. If it is not clear what they allow, the page stays reference only.

classes.pages: Anything else, or a page not clearly within one class above
classes.conditions: Never named in rights_status: it stays 'pending human rights review' for the product owner, page by page (OI-07).

policy.counts: Failure-only attempts (attempt_cases) do not count toward the 20/10/3 page minimums.
policy.holdout_split: Assign tuning or holdout by source/template family before any prompt or parser tuning, so near-duplicate pages never appear in both (plan section 9).

slot_template.label_review: not run - requires human domain reviewer

slots.note: Same vacancy as J02 on a different source; keeps both source copies, counts once.
Needs a permitted public page that shows provider-predicted pay. Adzuna has no credentials (R4); if no such page exists, record this slot as blocked, never synthesise it.
A posting observed open and later closed, or marked closed on the page.
Title that maps to more than one UK SOC 2020 unit group; unresolved alternatives retained.
Snippet and full text of the same posting; the snippet never becomes a full description.
Staffing agency advert; an undisclosed employer stays undisclosed.
Needs two retrievals of one template (or source) with a markup change; the second capture may fall in Sprint 5.
A real public posting with model-directed instructions, if one is permitted. Otherwise record the real-corpus gap and cover the case with a labelled synthetic page on the controlled test server.
Ordinary full posting with JSON-LD JobPosting.
Ordinary full posting, HTML only (no structured data).
Total fee versus instalment or upfront schedule.
Assessed work sample or exam that supports a level anchor.
Dated intakes and an application deadline.
Credential with an issuing or recognising body.
Apprenticeship or other composite work-and-learning offer.
Capture an actual current Skills Bootcamps programme or eligibility page found through the discovery source, not the discovery page itself (pack funding_note).

attempt_cases.note: A real URL that returns 404 or 410; recorded as a SourceAttempt, never as 'no vacancies'.
A fetch refused by robots policy, source policy or access control; recorded as a policy-denied SourceAttempt, never bypassed.

funding_note: Capture an actual current Skills Bootcamps programme/eligibility page found through the official discovery source. Funding must be checked by course start date/provider; the three-page minimum is not a complete funding-rule corpus.

open_items.owner: Task 8 (Sprint 3), using the Task 7 acquisition pipeline
open_items.disposition: Curate under R3 in slots J01-J20. Prefer employer ATS and authorised board pages. No sign-in walls. LinkedIn and Indeed are excluded unless an integration permits them.
Curate under R3 in slots C01-C10, including misleading titles and teaching without assessment (plan Sprint 4).
Fetch from the three official discovery sources; F03 must be a real Skills Bootcamps programme page.

Adzuna has no credentials (R4). Use a permitted public page that labels pay as predicted if one exists; otherwise record J03 as blocked. The Adzuna adapter's predicted-pay contract is covered by its fixture contract, labelled synthetic.

Search for a permitted real example. If none, cover the case with a labelled synthetic page on the controlled test server and report the real-corpus gap; never present the synthetic page as real evidence.

open_items.item: DOM drift needs two captures over time (J10)
open_items.disposition: Capture in Sprint 3, recapture in Sprint 5. If the markup has not changed, use a second page of the same template family that differs, or record the case as not yet observed.

open_items.item: Rights review of every retained page outside the rights policy's classes
open_items.owner: Human: product owner or delegated rights reviewer
open_items.disposition: The rights policy was set by the product owner at session 1 (2026-10-28, policy.rights_policy): agents classify each page against its classes and record the class and the terms relied on. A page outside the classes, or not clearly within one, stays 'pending human rights review' until a person reviews it: not run - requires human (R2). Checklist: corpus/README.md.

open_items.item: Review of consequential labels (salary basis, fees, deadlines, award status, outcome levels)
open_items.disposition: Not run - requires human (R2). Agents label and record spans; any unsupported consequential outcome blocks the affected route (plan Sprint 4).

open_items.owner: Task 7 (Sprint 3), before the first extraction tuning
open_items.disposition: Assign split per template family; record it in each slot; never move a case after tuning has used it.

open_items.item: Private evidence directory path, backup and deletion
open_items.owner: Task 3 (Sprint 1) path and runbook; Task 16 (Sprint 9) backup and restore
open_items.disposition: Proposed var/evidence/corpus/ (gitignored). Corpus bodies are excluded from git and from database dumps unless the runbook says otherwise.

open_items.item: Source permission manifest (spec section 6: permitted domains, robots and access decisions, rate limits, retained fields, attribution)
open_items.disposition: Separate checked-in manifest created with the acquisition worker; this corpus manifest records per-page rights only.
